code: import{createAsyncThunk,createSlice}from"@reduxjs/toolkit";import guarantorService from"../services/guarantorService";const initialState={guarantorInfo:[],isLoading:false,isError:false,isSuccess:false};export const checkExistingGuarantor=createAsyncThunk("checkExistingGuarantor",async({body},thunkAPI)=>{try{return await guarantorService.checkExistingGuarantor(body);}catch(error){const message=error.response&&error.response.data&&error.response.data.message||error.message||error.toString();return thunkAPI.rejectWithValue(message);}});export const guarantorCheckNrcSlice=createSlice({name:"checkGuarantors",initialState,reducers:{reset:state=>initialState},extraReducers:builder=>{builder.addCase(checkExistingGuarantor.pending,state=>{state.isLoading=true;}).addCase(checkExistingGuarantor.fulfilled,(state,action)=>{state.isSuccess=true;state.guarantorInfo=action.payload.data;state.isLoading=false;}).addCase(checkExistingGuarantor.rejected,(state,action)=>{state.isLoading=false;state.isError=true;state.message=action.payload;});}});export const{reset}=guarantorCheckNrcSlice.actions;export default guarantorCheckNrcSlice.reducer;
